h1: Custom Heat Transfer Koozies for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Heat Transfer Koozies | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom heat transfer koozies for your brand. Vibrant full-color designs on premium koozies. Perfect for events and giveaways.
introHtml: Custom heat transfer koozies give you the ability to apply full-color logos, photos, or intricate artwork directly onto the fabric. Unlike screen printing, heat transfer allows for gradient colors and fine details without setup fees for each color. This makes them ideal for promotional campaigns requiring photorealistic branding or complex designs. Choose from neoprene or foam koozies to keep drinks cold while showcasing your message with crisp, durable graphics.
heroAltText: Custom heat transfer koozies with full-color logo design on neoprene, perfect for promotional giveaways and events.
